groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Telegram groups the bot posts company news to. Choose what each one gets and whose news.
groups.add: Add the bot to a group
groups.emptyBody: Owners keep a private group for money news and a team group per branch. Add the bot to one and it starts posting.
groups.step1.title: Add the bot
groups.step1.body: Press the button and pick a group: {bot} joins it.
groups.step2.title: It connects itself
groups.step2.body: When a manager adds it, the group links to this company. Or send /connect in the group.
groups.step3.title: Choose what it gets
groups.step3.body: Finished tasks, late ones, the morning plan, the evening summary and more.
groups.positionsHint: Task news only about people in these positions.
groups.positionsIdle: Applies to news about one person, like finished or late tasks.
groups.disconnectBody: The bot stops posting there. The group itself stays; add the bot again to reconnect it.
groups.reconnectHint: Add the bot again to reconnect
groups.footer: Posts are spaced out so a busy group never hits Telegram’s limits.
groups.cmd.add: Add the bot to a Telegram group
